name: SHoEbox MAD-style capability protocol v1
claim: SHoEbox byte adaptation; not the original MAD score
selection: lowest mean final development task NLL across paired seeds; test only the selected hyperparameters
training_objective: masked answer-token loss plus existing native auxiliary objectives; compression uses a separately trained single-vector MLP readout
alignment: each answer delimiter completes a real 64-byte L3 constituent; all padding is observed and charged to the input-byte budget
difficulty_selection: control development accuracy only; explicit uncalibrated status when no setting is in the target band
timing: serial pinned CPU; compilation, dataset generation, evaluation and checkpoint I/O excluded from training; episode reset and final retirement included
promotion: three paired seeds, calibrated held-out capability gain, matched-byte and matched-time evidence, frozen contribution checks, and a separate matched natural-language guardrail
